title: Log configuration body
description: A setting that changes how the log judges later records, written into the log so the value travels with it and a replay needs no deployment option (register row DK312; spec-delta S972). Signed by the operator and co-signed by the owner. bond_floor_from: the time from which the bond floor of the deployment's mode (v2 or v3) applies; it is set once, at or after the record's own time, and never changed. Chain: none (prev is null).
